verdict.rationale: Several evidence items (docs-31, docs-39, docs-40) are quoted directly from a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json, which describes the Lambda Cloud REST API. That shows a downloadable spec exists. The probe 404s only cover candidate paths on docs.lambda.ai, so they do not contradict a spec served from the cloud.lambda.ai domain. missing for 10: no documentation page pointing users to the spec (it is not discoverable at standard docs paths), no independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using it.
